description: Verification runs (--verify; README, Correctness) of the five 128 MiB update configurations whose writers prune by key (configs/w128k-upd-*.json, campaign w128-keys-2): every read checks each row it returns against the reference model, and payloads are not checked (the configs' verifyRows is off). Nothing is measured: the laptop's runs of the same configurations measure, and these vouch for them, request for request and byte for byte (steps_diff). One configuration a job; 240 writes each.
